messages:
meera: quick heads-up, ran kv cache quant bake comparing awq8-kv vs int8-gptq on ivy30b-compact.
alex: summary pls?
meera: short: mem peak 44GB -> 31GB (~-30%), steady p95 82ms -> 60ms. eval-2k QA suite: EM -0.9% absolute, ppl +1.1.
bench-bot: report: mem_delta=-29.5%, p95_delta=-26.8%, em_delta=-0.9, ppl_delta=+1.1
sophie: did you test mixed rollout (clients hitting different quant variants)?
meera: yes — mixed traffic shows cache reuse drop: baseline reuse=94% -> mixed=79%.
ryan: where are misses coming from? serialization differences or numeric drift?
meera: two root causes found:
- AWQ blob layout: no explicit version header, ordering of small metadata fields differs.
- quant rounding changed prefill token key strings for some token sequences (mostly long contexts).
alex: can you share the repro command you used?
meera: pasted snippet:
```
./bench --model ivy30b --quant awq8-kv --batch 4 --seq 2048 --kv-cache on --warmup 100
./bench --model ivy30b --quant int8-gptq --batch 4 --seq 2048 --kv-cache on --warmup 100
python tools/kv_diff.py --dirA out_awq --dirB out_int8 --eps 1e-4 --report mismatch.csv
```
sophie: that ordering/format mismatch will change blob fingerprints and break cache key equality.
ryan: impact on user-facing latency? cold tail?
meera: steady-state latency improved but cold p99 worsened in mixed: p99 480ms -> 610ms due to forced re-prefill for mismatched sessions.
alex: what's the mitigation plan?
meera: short-term:
1) add a tiny version header to KV blobs (backwards safe). implements in one sprint.
2) canonicalize key serialization to deterministic fmt across backends.
3) rollout with a mismatch detector: if mismatch_ratio>5% trigger session-level full prefill.
sophie: long-term: build cross-quant key map so different encodings map to shared canonical ids (bigger project).
alex: rollout proposal: canary 0.5% hosted, 3% dedicated; require EM delta <=0.5% absolute and cache mismatch <=5% or auto-rollback.
bench-bot: shadow run with header+canon: reuse->91%, p95=63ms, mem=32GB, em_delta=-0.6, ppl_delta=+1.0
ryan: -0.6% still tight for some enterprise SLAs.
meera: agreed. we'll gate promotion with an eval job: run core 2k prompt regression and require sign-test pass + EM threshold.
sophie: ops note: if mismatch spike happens in prod, we fallback the session to pinned int8-gptq or force re-prefill to avoid quality tail.
deploy-bot: rollout plan created: kv-compat-v1 -> 0.5% hosted canary -> monitor 24h -> escalate on thresholds.
alex: docs/sdks need a note about the blob version and compatibility expectations.
meera: will open PR with header + kv_diff outputs and upload artifacts.
bench-bot: full logs: s3://redwood-ml/bench/2345678901/kv_compat_logs.tar.gz
sophie: thanks all, I'll draft internal KB for support and solutions teams.
alex: nice work everyone :thumbsup:
